title: Which hyperPad App Should You Download?
summary: Compare hyperPad Starter, hyperPad Hub, and hyperPad: build one project free, play community games, or make unlimited projects and export to the App Store.
body_markdown:
If you want to **make your own iPad games** , **experiment with interactive stories** , or **explore what other creators have made** , hyperPad has three apps for you. Picking the right one first gets you started faster.


Here's how **hyperPad Starter, hyperPad Hub, and hyperPad** compare, so you can choose the one that fits.


## 1. hyperPad Starter (Free): Build Your First Project Today


**Download here:**[hyperPad Starter on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6737631128)


**Best for:** Beginners who want to **try game development right away**


hyperPad Starter is the free way to start making games on iPad.


### Key Features:


- **Make 1 project.** Try out ideas, mechanics, and layouts.
- **The full visual editor.** Drag, drop, and connect Behaviors without coding.
- **Touch-based workflow.** Design, test, and play on your iPad.


### Why You Should Try It:


If you've never built a game before, hyperPad Starter gets you **hands-on right away** . There's no subscription and no setup. Open the app and start building. One project is enough to learn the basics of **level design, interactive Objects, and simple gameplay mechanics** .


**Pro tip:** Start with a small idea, like a simple runner or a puzzle game. You get a **taste of making a game without feeling overwhelmed** .


## 2. hyperPad Hub (Free): Explore, Play, and Get Inspired


**Download here:**[hyperPad Hub on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1484881474)


**Best for:** Players who want to **play community games** and find ideas before they build.


hyperPad Hub is where you play. You don't build games in it.


### Key Features:


- Browse **games made by hyperPad creators** .
- Play **interactive stories, platformers, puzzle games, and more** .
- Spot **trending ideas** and see what's possible before you start building.


### Why You Should Try It:


If you're not ready to build yet, or you want fresh ideas, start with hyperPad Hub. Playing community games shows you **popular game mechanics** and what creators make without writing a line of code.


**Pro tip:** Use the Hub to study. Note what works in the games you play, then try similar ideas in your own projects.


## 3. hyperPad (USD $14.99 One-Time): Unlimited Projects and App Store Export


**Download here:**[hyperPad on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id886106438)


**Best for:** Creators ready to **build more than one game**


hyperPad is the paid app for indie developers, educators, and game designers who have outgrown a single project.


### Key Features:


- **Unlimited projects.** Make as many games or interactive projects as you want.
- **App Store export.** Export your game to the App Store. You keep 100% of your revenue.
- **One-time payment.** There's no subscription and no recurring fee.


### Why You Should Try It:


If you're committed to **learning game development** , hyperPad lifts the one-project limit. It's a good fit for:


- Indie developers prototyping several game ideas.
- Artists turning illustrations into interactive experiences.
- Teachers designing educational games.


**Pro tip:** Start by recreating a simple game you love, then add your own mechanics on top. With no project limit, you can **prototype one idea after another** .


## Quick Comparison Table


## Which One Should You Download First?


- **If you want to try building right away:** start with **hyperPad Starter** .
- **If you want to play and get inspired first:** download **hyperPad Hub** .
- **If you're ready for more than one project, or you want to export to the App Store:** get **hyperPad** .


hyperPad Starter and hyperPad Hub are free. hyperPad is a one-time USD $14.99 purchase. You can **mix and match depending on your goals** . Start with Starter or the Hub, then upgrade to hyperPad when you want more projects.


## Start Creating Today


Whether you're **curious, looking for ideas, or ready to go deep** , one of these apps fits. They make game creation on iPad approachable for **first-time creators and indie developers** alike.


**Download the app that fits your goals:**


- [hyperPad Starter: free, no ads](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6737631128)
- [hyperPad Hub: free, no ads](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1484881474)
- [hyperPad: USD $14.99 one-time, no subscription or ads](https://apps.apple.com/app/id886106438)


Build your first game, play what the community has made, or go straight to hyperPad with no project limit. **The choice is yours.**
